mapper.select: SELECT season_id AS seasonId, season_name AS seasonName, TO_CHAR(start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS startDate, TO_CHAR(end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS endDate, season_ratio AS seasonRatio, is_active AS isActive FROM SEASON ORDER BY season_id ASC

SELECT season_id AS seasonId, season_name AS seasonName, TO_CHAR(start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS startDate, TO_CHAR(end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS endDate, season_ratio AS seasonRatio, is_active AS isActive FROM SEASON WHERE season_id = #{seasonId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SEASON ( season_name, start_date, end_date, season_ratio, is_active ) VALUES ( #{seasonName}, TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{seasonRatio}, NVL(#{isActive, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y') )
mapper.update: UPDATE SEASON SET season_name = #{seasonName}, start_date = TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), end_date = TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), season_ratio = #{seasonRatio}, is_active = #{isActive} WHERE season_id = #{seasonId}
